record.question: India is a republic because
options: The Head of the Government is elected by the people
The Government is responsible to the Parliament
The Constitution of India is supreme and made by a Constituent Assembly
The Head of the State is elected directly or indirectly by the people
record.explanation: India is a republic because it has an elected head of state (the President) rather than a hereditary monarch, which is the fundamental principle of a republic.
